summary: R. Gayathri is an Indologist who, attested in 2026, was a Ph.D. scholar at the Kuppuswami Sastri Research Institute under doctoral supervisor V. Yamuna Devi.

R. Gordon Wasson (1898-1986) worked in religious studies and Indology. He studied at the London School of Economics and Columbia University, later working at Guaranty Trust Company (1928-1934) and J.P. Morgan & Co. (1934-1963).

R. H. Blyth (1898-1964) was a scholar of Japanology and Buddhist studies who studied at the University of London (~1919-1923). He held posts at Keijo Imperial University (~1925-1940) and Kanazawa University (~1940-1942).

R. H. Tawney (1880-1962) was a historian who studied at Balliol College, Oxford (~1899-1903). He held academic posts at the University of Glasgow (~1906-1908) and the London School of Economics (~1913-1949).
R. N. Gadre was an Indology scholar who served as Professor of Sanskrit at Sir Parashurambhau College and Savitribai Phule Pune University, both attested in 1958.
R. P. Paranjpye (1876-1966) studied under Vaman Shivram Apte. He served as Vice-Chancellor of Savitribai Phule Pune University, attested in 1959.
R. Ramanujachari worked in philosophy and Indology. He was Professor of Philosophy at Annamalai University (attested 1938-1940) and editor of the Journal of the Annamalai University (attested 1950).

R. Sathyanarayana (1927-2020) was an Indologist who earned a Master's in chemistry at the University of Mysore. He taught at Sarada Vilas College (1949-1984) and served as President of the Indian Music Congress.
R. T. Vyas was an Indologist who served as General Editor for Gaekwad's Oriental Series (attested 1988) and Director of the Oriental Institute, Vadodara (1993-1994).

R. Thangaswami Sarma (1924-2000) was an Indology and philosophy scholar educated at Annamalai University and Madras Sanskrit College. He served as Śāstrachūḍāmaṇi Professor at Kuppuswami Sastri Research Institute and Honorary Professor at Adyar Library (1994-2000).

R. Venkatraman, a scholar of history, archaeology, and Indology, completed his PhD at Madurai Kamaraj University (1975-1980) under N. Subrahmanian and N. Jagadeesan, later serving there as Reader (attested 1990).
Rabindranath Tagore (1861-1941) was a philosopher who studied at University College London (~1878-1880). He founded Visva-Bharati University and the Sino-Indian Cultural Society.
Rachael Wiseman is a philosopher who studied at the University of York and served as a lecturer at the University of Liverpool (~2014).

Rachel H. Pang, a scholar of Tibetology, Buddhist studies, and religious studies, completed her PhD at the University of Virginia and served as Assistant Professor of Religious Studies at Davidson College (attested 2019).

Rachelle M. Scott specializes in Buddhist and religious studies. She completed her dissertation at Northwestern University under George D. Bond and Robert Launay, and held a post at the University of Tennessee (attested 2009-2017).
Radha Burnier (1923-2013) worked in Indology and philosophy, studying at Kalakshetra and Banaras Hindu University. She served as Director of the Adyar Library and Research Centre (~1954-1980).

Radha Krishna Choudhary (1921-1985) was a historian and Indologist who studied at Patna University. He headed the History Department at Ganesh Dutt College (1946) and taught history at Tilka Manjhi Bhagalpur University (1974-1984).

Radha Kumud Mukherjee (1884-1963) was an Indology and history scholar who studied at the University of Calcutta (~1901-1906). He held posts at Banaras Hindu University (~1916-1917) and the University of Mysore (~1917-1921).

Radhika Herzberger (born 1938) is an Indology and philosophy scholar. She earned her PhD at the University of Toronto (~1976-1982) under Bimal Krishna Matilal and served as Director of Rishi Valley School (~1980-2012).

Radoslav Katičić (1930-2019) was a linguist and Indologist who studied at the University of Zagreb (~1949-1954). He held a post at the University of Vienna (~1977-1998) and was a member of the Croatian Academy of Sciences and Arts (~1986-2019).
